SELECT s."id", s."rel", s."pop", s."views", s."pub" FROM (
      SELECT v."id", v."views"::int AS "views", coalesce(v."publishedAt", v."createdAt") AS "pub",
        floor(ln(v."views" + 1))::int AS "pop", ((CASE WHEN position($1 in n."nt") > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN position($2 in n."ng") > 0 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN v."category" = ANY ($3::text[]) THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN v."creatorId" = ANY ($4::text[]) THEN 4 ELSE 0 END))::int AS "rel"
      FROM "Video" v
      JOIN "Creator" c ON c."id" = v."creatorId"
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT
        video_search_normalize(concat_ws(' ', v."title", v."titleEn")) AS "nt",
        video_search_normalize(array_to_string(v."tags", ' ')) AS "ng") n
      WHERE 
    v."status" = 'PUBLISHED'::"VideoStatus"
    AND v."moderationStatus" <> 'REMOVED'::"VideoModerationStatus"
    AND v."moderationStatus" <> 'AGE_RESTRICTED'::"VideoModerationStatus" AND v."isAdult" = false
    AND (v."publishedAt" IS NULL OR v."publishedAt" <= $5::timestamp)
    AND (v."premiereAt" IS NULL OR v."premiereAt" <= $6::timestamp)
    AND c."status" IN ('ACTIVE'::"ChannelStatus", 'LIMITED'::"ChannelStatus")
    AND c."deletedAt" IS NULL AND (to_tsvector('simple', v."searchText") @@ to_tsquery('simple', $7) OR v."creatorId" = ANY ($8::text[]) OR v."category" = ANY ($9::text[]))
    ) s
    
    ORDER BY s."rel" DESC, s."pop" DESC, s."pub" DESC, s."id" DESC
    LIMIT $10
